summary.text: Scott Tippetts is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State Senate District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Clint Dixon.
A research scientist and statistician, he advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Scott Tippetts earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1987, and his career experience includes working as a scientist, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked for more than 30 years as a research scientist and statistician specializing in public policy evaluation, with projects sponsored by federal agencies and state departments of public safety.
He said he has published more than 50 peer-reviewed scientific papers on public policy.
